panels.title: PnL luy ke thuc te (engine_state — nguon dung)
panels.description: PnL luy ke dung cua tai khoan giay (engine_state), gom ca cac can thiep thu cong (nhu dong vi the HII ngay 10/09); khac voi panel 'PnL theo ngay' von chi ghi nhan lenh tu dong.

targets.rawSql: SELECT realized_pnl AS "Realized PnL luy ke", cash AS "Tien mat", updated_at AS "Cap nhat luc", round(extract(epoch FROM (now() - updated_at)) / 86400) AS "So ngay truoc" FROM engine_state WHERE id = 1
SELECT ts AS time, close FROM bars WHERE symbol = '$symbol' ORDER BY ts

panels.title: PnL theo ngay (chi lenh tu dong)
panels.description: Bang pnl_daily chi ghi ngay co lenh khop tu dong; khong co dong cho ngay khong co lenh; khong gom can thiep thu cong (vi du khoan dong tay HII ngay 10/09); va so ngay 14/08 con thieu phi mua vi chay truoc commit 6664cd9. Xem docs/superpowers/research/2026-09-19-dot-68-lech-pnl-giua-engine-state-va-pnl-daily.md.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date AS time, realized, unrealized, fees FROM pnl_daily ORDER BY date
SELECT symbol, qty, avg_price, updated_at FROM positions WHERE qty > 0
SELECT service, last_seen, extract(epoch from (now() - last_seen)) AS age_seconds FROM heartbeat
SELECT ts AS time, account_no AS metric, account_balance AS value FROM account_balance_snapshot ORDER BY ts

SELECT account_no, symbol, quantity, cost_price, sellable_quantity, ts FROM account_position_snapshot aps WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM account_position_snapshot WHERE account_no = aps.account_no) ORDER BY account_no, symbol

SELECT b.account_no, b.ts, b.account_balance, b.floating_pl, b.total_pl, m.rc_call, m.account_ratio_ssi, m.account_ratio_vsdc FROM derivative_balance_snapshot b JOIN derivative_margin_snapshot m ON m.account_no = b.account_no AND m.ts = b.ts WHERE b.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM derivative_balance_snapshot WHERE account_no = b.account_no)

list.name: symbol
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM bars WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY 1
list.description: Doi ro ma khong can sua panel (truoc day hardcode VCB — panel dung hinh sau 63e6028). Cua so 7 ngay con lan VCB/HPG/TCB khoang 1 tuan nua roi tu rung. 7 ngay thay vi 2: sang thu Hai cua so 2 ngay RONG (cuoi tuan khong bar) nen bien khong co gia tri.
